content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Job Description
content_sections.text: Communication and Analytics Manager Build and document data pipelines (ETL) that consolidate data from MIS, ERP, HR, academic and finance systems into an analytical layer. Integrate and maintain academic and administrative datasets of the Institute. Develop and maintain dashboards and periodic reports for institutional decision-making covering academic performance and programme outcomes. Prepare data submissions and analyses for statutory and ranking exercises (NIRF, AISHE, QS, THE, AICTE) and reporting. Design and execute exploratory and confirmatory analyses to answer specific questions. Any other relevant task assigned by the Advisor/ Dean (CDO) from time to time. Junior Multimedia Specialist Assist in the creation of multimedia content for the Institute, including posters, brochures, social-media creatives, event publicity materials, photography, videography, and basic video editing for official communication channels. Support the Communication and Analytics Manager in managing digital content archives, data collection, and assisting in the scheduling and dissemination of content across social media platforms.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Master's degree (M.Sc. / M.Tech. / M.S. / M.A. / MBA / MPP) in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Public Policy, or an allied quantitative discipline; OR A four-year Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech. / B.S. or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Mathematics and Computing, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or another relevant computational discipline. Experience required: Minimum two years for postgraduates or four years for graduates of relevant experience in data analysis and management, statistical analysis, and institutional/business analytics in educational institutions or reputed organisations. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: ₹35,000 – ₹50,000 per month. Qualification required: Bachelor's degree in Multimedia / Mass Communication / Journalism / Visual Communication / Graphic Design / Animation OR any Bachelor's degree with a Diploma/ Certificate in Multimedia, Graphic Design, Video Editing, or related field. Experience required: Minimum 1 year of experience in graphic design/ video editing/ photography/ AI Prompting Skills/ social-media content creation in a reputed organisation/educational institution. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: ₹25,000 - ₹35,000 per month.
